source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 1. Bios Setting EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> Processor Configuration -> Lock Chipset -> Disabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> Processor Configuration -> MSR Lock Control -> Disabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> IIO Configuration -> IIO DFX Configuration -> EV DFX features -> Enabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> IIO Configuration -> IIO DFX Configuration -> Disable BIOS Done -> [‘X’] EDKII Menu -> Platform Configuration -> System Event Log -> Error Injection Settings -> WHEA Error Injection Support -> Enabled EDKII Menu -> Platform Configuration -> System Event Log -> Error Injection Settings -> Whea PCIE Error Injection Action Table -> Enabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> Memory Configuration -> Memory RAS Configuration -> ADDDC Sparing-> Enable 2. Install 64GB x4 bit DIMM on SUT. 3. Deploy Intel ITP environment. 4. Boot SUT into Windows. 5. Execute Intel Cscripts on the client 6. Using following command >>>itp.log(""""C:\Test.log"""") >>>halt() >>>mc.dimminfo() >>>ras.DeviceSparingHarasser(runTime, adddc, adddcType, plus1, socket, mc, ch, adjacent=True, debug=False, skipSelfCheck=False ) >>>go 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 1. System should work normally 2. BMC error log should record which slot has DIMM correctable error 3. Front Panel fault Light will not Light if there is one 4. Corresponding DIMM lightpath will not light if there is one 5. uEFI SEL Log should record which slot has a DIMM correctable error if there is one" 6. Cscript log should record 'sparing_harasser PASSED'
source_snapshot.deepseek_direct_xlsx: NO | -- Advanced RAS Rank without plus1 (Intel ADDDC sparing Advanced RAS Rank without plus1 error injection): requires CScripts/EDKII unlock (Lock Chipset=Disable, MSR Lock Control=Disable, EV DFX Features=Enable, WHEA Error Injection Support=Enable) + the user/FAE to drive the Cscript/error-injection harness for this exact pattern. Agent captures the post-injection evidence with sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "dmesg -T 2>&1 | tail -180 | grep -iE 'sparing|harasser|adddc|DIMM.correctable|corrected|spar_harasser'; echo __ADDDC_sparing_Advanced_RAS_Rank_without_plus1; ipmitool sel elist 2>&1 | tail -40 2>&1".
